exceptions.reason: The bar writes `aria-orientation`, and CSS selects `[aria-orientation]`. CSS selects a bar with an open menu with `:has([aria-expanded="true"])`, so the bar writes no `data-has-submenu-open`. It writes no `data-modal`, which repeats a prop. The family has no namespace of constants.

`Menubar.test.ts` tests the bar: its role and its one tab stop, the keys of the bar, a disabled trigger, the open of a menu with the key across the bar, the move to another menu at a pointer move, at a tap and at an arrow key, the outside press, and the modal state. The cases that Base UI runs in three forms of the bar run in the same three forms: a root around each trigger, one root around all the triggers, and one root outside the bar whose handle each trigger has.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part declares `id` and writes it on its element. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the menubar, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
